handedBack now reads only !ack_wait_owed, and ack_wait_owed is set only by handBack during an ack-wait hold and by a stuck abandon. Three exits release unsettled without it while a lost node's binding may still be open (stale_binding on the record): a graceful stop whose linger ends 'not taken' (no standby; lingerUntaken 1 s) so the frozen connection is the deliver subject's only subscriber until a later pod subscribes; a holder that took a hand-back and gives up after 135 s (settle && !HandedBack false); a Stop before the term subscribed (Release writes unsettled from the acquiring write, ack_wait_owed false). The next pod gets the 3 s cap while messages pushed to the lost binding alone come back only at their 6 s ack wait, so they are delivered after newer ones in the same session. Before d3787812 the carried stale_binding forced 7 s in these cases.

awaitedBinding still survives a term ended by losing the lease: awaitUnbound returns termCtx's error when the lease watcher cancels the term, abandon takes the refuse path and returns before line 557. Another pod then takes and holds the record; if it dies hard, this pod's later expired take-over is counted as its own resume, settle is false, and the dead pod's messages arrive after newer ones.
